terminals.name: static-site
terminals.description: Serves the Happy Pixels static landing page (index.html, /imprint, /privacy-policy) at http://localhost:8000, mirroring GitHub Pages.

terminals.name: worker-dev
terminals.command: cd workers && npx --yes wrangler@4 dev early-access.js --name happy-pixels-early-access --compatibility-date 2024-01-01 --port 8787 --ip 127.0.0.1
terminals.description: Runs the early-access Cloudflare Worker locally at http://localhost:8787. Set BREVO_API_KEY and BREVO_LIST_ID (e.g. via `wrangler secret put`) to enable real Brevo signups; without them it responds 503 'Signup is not configured yet.'
